$description: Myelin's primitive, semantic, and component design tokens for dark, light, and high-contrast themes.

primitive.$description: Tier 1 — raw values, no meaning. Three neutral ramps (dark/light/high-contrast 50->950 sense), one rationed brand ramp + its DERIVED AA-safe focus steps, functional ramps (success/warning/danger/info), the reserved neutral agent ramp, type scale, font families, spacing (4px base), radius, elevation, motion, z-index. Never consumed by components directly.

neutral-dark.$description: Cool-grey ramp for the midnight (dark) theme. 0 = app base; ascending = raised surfaces; 4 = hairline; txt-* = on-base text steps. MEASURED ratios on #0c0d10.

4.$description: hairline border (decorative, 1.30:1 — not an essential-UI pair)

neutral-light.$description: Light-theme ramp. Pure white base is acceptable here (Instrument is crisp, not warm). MEASURED ratios on #ffffff.

neutral-hc.$description: High-contrast ramp: pure-black base, near-white text, AAA-grade everything, borders lifted to >=3:1 (the 1.4.11 UI floor) — borders are essential UI here, not decoration. Mirrors `forced-colors` intent as an authored theme. MEASURED ratios on #000000.

blue.$description: The ONE rationed identity accent family + its DERIVED, AA-safe focus/primary-action steps. identity-* = brand identity ONLY (never the sole carrier of focus). focus-* = the derived focus-ring/primary token, DISTINCT and higher-contrast than identity (design-language §8b.3; R-17 §3.2). weak-* = tint fill for selected/active backgrounds.

identity-light.$description: identity accent, light — 4.50:1 on base (exactly AA; identity, not focus)

focus-dark.$description: DERIVED focus/primary, dark — 8.13:1 on base; on-focus #0c0d10 = 8.13:1

focus-light.$description: DERIVED focus/primary, light — 6.55:1 on base; white-on-it = 6.55:1

focus-hc.$description: DERIVED focus/primary, high-contrast — 12.14:1 on base; on-focus #000 = 12.14:1

green.$description: Functional SUCCESS ramp (CI pass, merged, healthy). Muted, never a saturated traffic-light fill (§8b.3). Always paired with glyph+label (status-not-by-colour, WCAG 1.4.1).

amber.$description: Functional WARNING ramp (SLA at-risk, degraded). Muted gold; never alarm-red. Paired with glyph+label.

red.$description: Functional DANGER ramp (CI fail, SLA breach, destructive). Paired with glyph+label.

info.$description: Functional INFO ramp. Aliased to the DERIVED focus/primary blue so info reads as the same calm blue family as primary actions (distinct from the identity accent so info never competes with brand). Paired with glyph+label.

violet.$description: RESERVED AGENT family — a fourth NEUTRAL semantic axis, NOT a functional status colour (R-14 §1.2). Always paired with the text label 'Agent' + a plain geometric mark (never sparkle/shimmer/magic-wand, §8b.3) + attribution string. Carries 'this came from / awaits an agent' at a glance, never by colour alone.

diff.$description: Code-diff add/remove. Add/remove is NEVER conveyed by colour alone — the diff component announces 'added line'/'removed line' as TEXT (R-17 §5.1). add-txt/del-txt MEASURED against their own backgrounds.

dimension.$description: 4px-base spacing ramp + near-zero radius (Instrument is sharp/compact). HOUSE STYLE values; the 4px grid is the design-language §3.4 rule (off-ramp 5/7/13px is the amateur tell).

hairline.$description: borders-first: hairlines do nearly all grouping (§3.5)

typography.$description: One modular scale (~1.2 ratio) shared platform-wide; dense surfaces use the tighter steps, reading surfaces the larger. Self-hosted variable families, NO CDN (sovereignty/GDPR, §3.3). Coverage gate: Latin-extended + Greek + Cyrillic at minimum (R-18 §3.1); Arabic/Hebrew for RTL is a [VERIFY] selection gate before build.

sans.$description: UI/content sans. PROD = self-hosted Inter Variable (or equivalent) carrying Latin-ext+Greek+Cyrillic; the listed CDN/system fonts are dev-only fallbacks. [VERIFY] EU-24 + Greek + Cyrillic coverage before Phase 8 build.

mono.$description: Load-bearing monospace (SHAs, diffs, logs, inline code). Greek/Cyrillic comment coverage required (R-18 §3.2) so a non-Latin comment in a diff keeps column alignment.

display.$description: rare; hierarchy is weight/colour-first, not big type

lineHeight.$description: >=1.45 body for diacritic headroom (R-18 §3.2; never 1.0 — clips Greek tonos / Cyrillic breve / Latin-ext caron).

tight.$description: dense single-line rows (validated against accented Greek/Cyrillic)

elevation.$description: Borders-first, shadow RESERVED for genuinely floating layers only (palette, menu, popover, hovercard, toast, overlaid HITL card) — §3.5/§8b.3. Most grouping is a hairline border, not a shadow. Under high-contrast, shadows are visually inert (kept for layout but a border carries the layer).

duration.$description: Functional/fast motion band (R-12 §2.1). All <=240ms; reduced-motion zeroes these to `instant`. HOUSE STYLE values within the PROVEN 120-200ms budget (deliberate=240 is the only token above 200, reserved for notice-without-interrupt: live-update & agent-enter).

fast.$description: default functional transition (settle, chip update, overlay enter)

deliberate.$description: live-update & agent-enter — meant to be NOTICED, capped

easing.$description: Four canonical UI easing roles (R-12 §2.2). NO spring/bounce/overshoot primitive exists — deliberately omitted (reads playful, conflicts with the precise register & §8b.3).

standard.$description: move within view: quick out, soft in (default)

enter.$description: decelerate — new content arrives and rests

emphasized.$description: reserved AGENT signature curve (paired w/ deliberate dur)

zIndex.$description: ONE documented z-index scale (§8b.1): chrome < popover < modal < toast. Per-component magic z-index numbers are banned. All overlays portal to the document root.

toast.$description: toasts — above modals, never steal focus

semantic.$description: Tier 2 — meaning, THEME-AWARE. Components consume ONLY this tier (design-language §3.1). The theme override map ($themes) and the direction-swap (00-plan §2.1) both operate by re-pointing these aliases at different primitives — no component edit. The aliases below resolve to the DARK theme (Instrument's default 'midnight command-deck'); light & high-contrast re-point them in $themes.

border.$description: hairline grouping (decorative; the focus ring, not this, carries the 3:1 UI obligation)

accent.$description: IDENTITY ONLY — rail marker, brand. NEVER the sole carrier of focus or the primary-action fill.

focus-ring.$description: DERIVED, AA-safe, DISTINCT from accent. The ONE focus token on every interactive element (palette row / diff line / board card / editor block / HITL button / overlay control). 8.13:1 on surface; >=3:1 UI floor met everywhere.

agent.$description: RESERVED agent treatment — NOT a status colour; always label 'Agent' + plain geometric mark + attribution, never colour-alone (R-14 §1; WCAG 1.4.1)

component.$description: Tier 3 — OPTIONAL per-component overrides, each bound to a SEMANTIC token (never to a primitive). Shows components are tuned, not forked. A direction/theme swap flows through because these resolve to semantics. Empty per-component = inherit semantics directly.

button-primary-bg.$description: primary action rides the DERIVED token, NOT the identity accent (so the primary button always passes AA)

focus-ring.$description: ONE focus-ring token, every interactive element, every theme

rail-active-accent.$description: identity accent as a 2px inset rail marker, paired with weight/colour, never alone

overlay-scrim.$description: modal backdrop (rendered at reduced opacity in CSS)

control-height.$description: compact default (Instrument); comfortable density raises this via the `density` flag

$themes.$description: DTCG theme-set override map. Each theme re-points the SEMANTIC aliases at a different primitive ramp — the same mechanism as the direction-swap (00-plan §2.1). Style Dictionary emits one [data-theme] block per theme into tokens.css. `dark` is the default (the resolved semantic tier above). Only overridden aliases are listed; unlisted aliases inherit the default.

dark.$description: DEFAULT — Instrument 'midnight command-deck'. Identical to the resolved semantic tier above; listed for completeness.

high-contrast.$description: Authored high-contrast theme (EN 301 549 / WCAG 1.4.11). Pure-black base, AAA text, borders lifted to >=3:1 (essential UI). Pairs with the @media(forced-colors:active) CSS fallback in tokens.css.
